# Talvento Migration Field Mapping

The workbook mapping each Staffora field to its Talvento field, with the transformation rule for each. Maintained by [[rashid-karimi]] and [[mirela-dumitru]]; version 3.4 is the one used for the final migration.

## Summary

About 260 Staffora fields mapped to 190 Talvento fields; 38 Staffora fields deliberately not migrated (mostly unused free-text fields and pre-2015 codes). Key transformations: absence and leave from hours to days ([[absence-conversion-specification]]), cost centres from the old codes to the 2026 hierarchy ([[cost-centre-hierarchy-2026]]), duplicate persons with two employments to one person with two assignments.

## Why It Matters

I used it in UAT to know what a Talvento value should be. The absence row was the one that was wrong: version 2 converted carry-over at a flat 7.5 hours ([[uat-defect-review-2026-03-11]]). The 38 unmapped fields are part of the question of what happens to Staffora history ([[what-happens-to-staffora-history-after-2027-03-31]]).

## Source Location

HRIS programme folder, `Migration / Field mapping v3.4.xlsx`.
